dataDisclosure.message: When you request AI help, your messages, conversation context, selected/page text, or the visible tab screenshot (in Screenshot Mode) are sent to the API address above. The provider also receives your API key and connection metadata such as your IP address. Screenshots may include personal content visible on the page. Settings and up to 50 inline answers and 100 pending transfers are stored locally. The developer receives none of this data. Your provider may retain requests under its own policy.

apiKeyRetention.message: Your API key is kept in browser session memory and is cleared when Chrome restarts or the extension reloads. Other settings remain saved.
